title: Associated sheaf of an injective module over a Noetherian ring is flasque
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and M an injective R-module. The presheaf of R-modules (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde M)).presheaf on Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] is flasque: every restriction morphism is an epimorphism, equivalently a surjection of underlying sets. No locality or choice of puncture is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09T2, Lemma 36.8.1; affine equivalence between modules and quasi-coherent sheaves

proof.text: Spec R is Noetherian. Under the exact equivalence of R-modules with quasi-coherent sheaves on Spec R, M corresponds to an injective quasi-coherent sheaf. Tag 09T2 shows this sheaf is flasque: extend a section on an open to a morphism from a power of the coherent ideal defining its complement, then use injectivity to extend along that ideal into the structure sheaf.

Given V contained in U, first extend its section globally and then restrict to U. Forgetting to R-modules does not change the underlying restriction functions. ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective translates this into TopCat.Presheaf.IsFlasque for the presheaf in the statement. The empty open has only the zero section.

lean.statement:
theorem injective_tilde_isFlasque
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) [Injective M] :
    TopCat.Presheaf.IsFlasque (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (tilde (R := .of R) M)).presheaf
